[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]To make a complete guide on all[/n]the Pokémon in the world[...][/p]That was my dream!
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Prof. Oak may not look like much,[/n]but he's the authority on Pokémon.[/p]Many Pokémon Trainers hold him in[/n]high regard.
[文本色08][阴影色09]Family and friends?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Prof. Oak reportedly lives with his[/n]grandchildren, Daisy and [劲敌].

[文本色08][阴影色09]Family and friends?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]I hear Oak's taken a lot of[/n]interest in you, child.[/p]That old duff was once tough and[/n]handsome.[/p]But that was decades ago.[/n]He's a shadow of his former self.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What does this person do?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Prof. Oak is going to have his own[/n]radio show soon.[/p]The program will be called Prof.[/n]Oak's Pokémon Seminar.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What does this person do?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]If you show Daisy your Pokémon,[/n]she can tell how much it likes you.[/p]Occasionally, she will even groom[/n]a Pokémon for you.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]But the person who is most liked by[/n]Pokémon is Daisy, I think.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]She was gently grooming Pokémon[...][/n]She was a little angel.[/p]That little girl's name[...][/n]I think it was Daisy.
[文本色08][阴影色09]Family and friends?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Prof. Oak reportedly lives with his[/n]grandchildren, Daisy and [劲敌].
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]A girl from Pallet Town, Daisy,[/n]she enjoys Tea every day.[/p]She visits the Celadon Dept. Store[/n]to buy some Tea.
[文本色08][阴影色09]There's a rumor[...][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]The Spring Pokémon Contest's[/n]Grand Champion is Daisy Oak of[/l]Pallet Town!
[文本色08][阴影色09]What does this person do?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Pewter City Pokémon Gym[/n]Leader: Brock[/l]The Rock-Solid Pokémon Trainer!

[文本色08][阴影色09]Favorite kind of Pokémon?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]My rock-hard willpower is evident[/n]in even my Pokémon.[/p]My Pokémon are all rock hard and[/n]have true-grit determination.[/p]That's right - my Pokémon are all[/n]the Rock type!

[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]There aren't many serious Pokémon[/n]Trainers here.[/p]They're all like Bug Catchers,[/n]you know, just hobbyists.[/p]But Pewter Gym's Brock isn't like[/n]that, not one bit.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Brock is cool. He's not just tough.[/n]People like and respect him.[/p]I want to become a Gym Leader[/n]like him.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What does this person do?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Hi, I'm excavating for fossils here[/n]under Mt. Moon.[/p]Sometimes, Brock of Pewter Gym[/n]lends me a hand.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Brock rarely laughs, but is said to[/n]be unable to stop if he starts.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What does this person do?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Cerulean City Pokémon Gym[/n]Leader: Misty[/l]The Tomboyish Mermaid!
[文本色08][阴影色09]Favorite kind of Pokémon?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]My policy is an all-out offensive[/n]with Water-type Pokémon!
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Misty is a Trainer who's going to[/n]keep improving.[/p]She won't lose to someone like you!
[文本色08][阴影色09]There's a rumor[...][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Strong Trainers and Water Pokémon[/n]are common sights in these parts.[/p]They say that Misty of the[/n]Cerulean Gym trains here.
[文本色08][阴影色09]There's a rumor[...][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]This cape is a famous date spot.[/p]Misty, the Gym Leader, has high[/n]hopes about this place.
[文本色08][阴影色09]There's a rumor[...][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Misty is said to worship Lorelei[/n]of the Elite Four.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What does this person do?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Vermilion City Pokémon Gym[/n]Leader: Lt. Surge[/l]The Lightning American!
[文本色08][阴影色09]Favorite kind of Pokémon?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]I tell you, kid, electric Pokémon[/n]saved me during the war!
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]When I was in the Army, Lt. Surge[/n]was my strict CO.[/p]He was a hard taskmaster.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Lt. Surge was always famous for[/n]his cautious nature in the Army.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Lt. Surge installed the traps in[/n]the Gym himself.[/p]He set up double locks everywhere.
[文本色08][阴影色09]There's a rumor[...][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Lt. Surge is rumored to have been[/n]a pilot while home in America.[/p]He used the electricity generated[/n]by Pokémon to power his plane.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What does this person do?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Celadon City Pokémon Gym[/n]Leader: Erika[/l]The Nature-Loving Princess!
[文本色08][阴影色09]Favorite kind of Pokémon?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]I am a student of the art of[/n]flower arranging.[/p]My Pokémon are solely of the[/n]Grass type.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Our Leader Erika might be quiet,[/n]but she's famous around here.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]We only use Grass-type Pokémon at[/n]our Gym.[/p]Why? We also use them for making[/n]flower arrangements!
[文本色08][阴影色09]Favorite kind of Pokémon?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]I would never collect Pokémon if[/n]they were unattractive.
[文本色08][阴影色09]There's a rumor[...][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Rumor has it that if you peek into[/n]Celadon Gym, you can often[/l]see Erika snoozing.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What does this person do?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Fuchsia City Pokémon Gym[/n]Leader: Koga[/l]The Poisonous Ninja Master
[文本色08][阴影色09]Favorite kind of Pokémon?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Despair to the creeping horror of[/n]Poison-type Pokémon!
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Even though I've lost, I will keep[/n]training according to the teachings[/l]of Koga, my ninja master.
[文本色08][阴影色09]Family and friends?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]My father is the Gym Leader of[/n]this town.[/p]I'm training to use Poison Pokémon[/n]as well as my father.
[文本色08][阴影色09]There's a rumor[...][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Koga is said to have a thorough[/n]knowledge of medicine.[/p]He even concocts medicine to nurse[/n]his Pokémon to health.

[文本色08][阴影色09]What does this person do?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]The Safari Zone's huge, wouldn't[/n]you say?[/p]Fuchsia's Gym Leader, Koga, [/n]patrols the grounds every so often.[/p]Thanks to him, we can play here[/n]knowing that we're safe.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What does this person do?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Saffron City Pokémon Gym[/n]Leader: Sabrina[/l]The Master of Psychic Pokémon!
[文本色08][阴影色09]Favorite kind of Pokémon?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]You know about a girl Gym Leader[/n]in Saffron City?[/p]She uses Psychic-type Pokémon,[/n]right?
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]I have had psychic powers since[/n]I was a child.[/p]It started when a spoon I[/n]carelessly tossed, bent.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]I dislike battling, but if you wish,[/n]I will show you my powers!
[文本色08][阴影色09]There's a rumor[...][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]People say that Sabrina can[/n]communicate with her Pokémon[/l]during battle without speaking.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Sabrina just wiped out the Karate[/n]Master next door.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What does this person do?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Cinnabar Island Pokémon Gym[/n]Leader: Blaine[/l]The Hotheaded Quiz Master!
[文本色08][阴影色09]Favorite kind of Pokémon?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]My fiery Pokémon are all rough[/n]and ready with intense heat![/p]They incinerate all challengers!

[文本色08][阴影色09]Favorite kind of Pokémon?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Our Leader, Blaine, became lost[/n]in the mountains but good.[/p]Night fell when a fiery bird[/n]Pokémon appeared.[/p]Its light allowed Blaine to find[/n]his way down safely.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Cinnabar Gym's Blaine is quite the[/n]odd fellow.[/p]He's lived on the island since way[/n]before the Lab was built.
[文本色08][阴影色09]Family and friends?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]It's a photo of Blaine and[/n]Mr. Fuji.[/p]They're standing shoulder to[/n]shoulder with big grins.
[文本色08][阴影色09]There's a rumor[...][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Blaine is said to remove his dark[/n]shades only when he is thinking up[/l]new quiz questions.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What does this person do?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]I am Lorelei of the Elite Four.
[文本色08][阴影色09]Favorite kind of Pokémon?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]No one can best me when it comes[/n]to icy Pokémon.
[文本色08][阴影色09]Where was this person born?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]We've had a great and powerful[/n]Trainer grow up on this island.[/p]I bet even you'd know her.[/n]It's Lorelei of the Elite Four!
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Known for her logical, calculated,[/n]and cool battling style, Lorelei[/l]has a surprising secret!
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Did you know that Lorelei has lots[/n]and lots of stuffed dolls?[/p]Every time she comes back to[/n]Four Island, her collection grows!

[文本色08][阴影色09]Favorite kind of Pokémon?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]The Lapras she has, I imagine it[/n]to be the one she met as a child.[/p]I believe it was in Icefall Cave[/n]that she caught it.[/p]Perhaps that Pokémon has been with[/n]her ever since.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What does this person do?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]I am Bruno of the Elite Four!
[文本色08][阴影色09]Favorite kind of Pokémon?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]I've lived and trained with my[/n]fighting Pokémon!
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Bruno apparently joined the Elite[/n]Four out of his burning ambition to[/l]battle the best Trainers.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Bruno, who's a senior ahead of me,[/n]visits the Spa on occasion.[/p]He comes to rehab injuries, both[/n]his own and his Pokémon's.

[文本色08][阴影色09]There's a rumor[...][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]He's one of the Elite Four.[/n]His name is Bruno.[/p]He went away disappointed when he[/n]found out that they were all sold[/l]out of Rage Candybars.
[文本色08][阴影色09]Family and friends?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Even Bruno[...][/n]He trained with a fellow by the[/l]name of Brawly before.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What does this person do?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]I am Agatha of the Elite Four.
[文本色08][阴影色09]Favorite kind of Pokémon?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Agatha's Ghost-type Pokémon are[/n]horrifically terrifying in toughness.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]That old lady's also got a really[/n]short fuse, too.[/p]It doesn't take anything to get[/n]that scary lady hollering.
[文本色08][阴影色09]There's a rumor[...][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]In her youth, Agatha and Prof.[/n]Oak were rivals who vied for[/l]supremacy as Trainers.

[文本色08][阴影色09]Family and friends?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]I hear Oak's taken a lot of[/n]interest in you, child.[/p]That old duff was once tough and[/n]handsome.[/p]But that was decades ago.[/n]He's a shadow of his former self.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Take Agatha, for example.[/p]She set a record for being the[/n]oldest-ever Elite Four member.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What does this person do?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]I lead the Elite Four.[/p]You can call me Lance the dragon[/n]Trainer.

[文本色08][阴影色09]Favorite kind of Pokémon?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]You know that dragons are[/n]mythical Pokémon.[/p]They're hard to catch and raise,[/n]but their powers are superior.[/p]They're virtually indestructible.[/n]There's no being clever with them.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]He stands for justice![/n]He's cool, and yet passionate![/l]He's the greatest, Lance!
[文本色08][阴影色09]There's a rumor[...][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]We have a customer, Lance, who[/n]occasionally comes.[/p]He always buys capes.[/p]I wonder[...] Does he have many[/n]identical capes at home?
[文本色08][阴影色09]Family and friends?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Lance's grandfather is thought to[/n]be the elder of a famous clan of[/l]dragon masters.
[文本色08][阴影色09]Family and friends?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]From what I've heard, Lance has[/n]a cousin who's a Gym Leader[/l]somewhere far away.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What does this person do?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]After all, Bill's world-famous as a[/n]PokéManiac.[/p]He invented the Pokémon Storage[/n]System on PC, too.
[文本色08][阴影色09]Favorite kind of Pokémon?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Bill has lots of Pokémon![/n]He collects rare ones, too!
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]He's my grandson![/p]He always liked collecting things,[/n]even as a child!
[文本色08][阴影色09]Favorite kind of Pokémon?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Bill is a PokéManiac, so he loves[/n]every kind.[/p]Apparently, the first one he caught[/n]was an Abra.
[文本色08][阴影色09]Family and friends?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Bill's hometown is Goldenrod City,[/n]where his folks still live.[/p]I've heard that it's quite the[/n]festive, bustling city.
[文本色08][阴影色09]There's a rumor[...][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Apparently, Bill simply can't[/n]stomach milk at all.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What does this person do?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]He's really kind.[/p]He looks after abandoned and[/n]orphaned Pokémon.

[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]This old guy marched right up to[/n]our Hideout.[/p]Then, he starts ranting about how[/n]Team Rocket's abusing Pokémon.[/p]So, we're just talking it over as[/n]adults.

[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Pokémon Fan Magazine[/n]Monthly Grand Prize Drawing![/p]The application form is[...][/p]Gone! It's been clipped out.[/n]Someone must have applied already.
[文本色08][阴影色09]There's a rumor[...][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]I hear that Mr. Fuji's not from[/n]these parts originally, either.
[文本色08][阴影色09]Family and friends?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]It's a photo of Blaine and[/n]Mr. Fuji.[/p]They're standing shoulder to[/n]shoulder with big grins.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Editor: The shy Mr. Fuji turned[/n]down our interview requests.[/p]He is a kindly man who is adored[/n]and respected in Lavender Town.

[文本色08][阴影色09]What does this person do?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Team Rocket captures Pokémon from[/n]around the world.[/p]They're important tools for keeping[/n]our criminal enterprise going.[/p]I am the leader, Giovanni!
[文本色08][阴影色09]Favorite kind of Pokémon?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Those thugs that took over our[/n]building[...][/p]Their Boss said he was looking for[/n]strong Pokémon.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What is this person like?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Team Rocket's Boss is terribly[/n]cruel![/p]To him, Pokémon are just tools to[/n]be used.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What does this person do?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Welcome to my hideout![/p]It shall be so until I can restore[/n]Team Rocket to its former glory.
[文本色08][阴影色09]What does this person do?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Blow me away! Giovanni was the[/n]Gym Leader of Viridian?
[文本色08][阴影色09]Family and friends?[/p][文本色02][阴影色03]You[...] You're not Giovanni's kid,[/n]are you?[/p]No, that can't be right.[/n]Giovanni's kid has red hair.

[文本色08][阴影色09]From: Prof. Oak[/n]To: [玩家][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Why do Pokémon compete and battle[/n]so hard for you?[/p]They do so because they can see[/n]the love and trust you have[/l]towards Pokémon.[/p]Never forget that.

[文本色08][阴影色09]From: Daisy[/n]To: [玩家][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]While I was comfortably enjoying[/n]my tea breaks, you've grown very[/l]skilled and powerful.[/p]I hope you'll remain a good rival[/n]to my little brother.
[文本色08][阴影色09]From: Brock[/n]To: [玩家][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]In this big world of ours, there[/n]must be many tough Trainers.[/p]Let's both keep training and[/n]making ourselves stronger!
[文本色08][阴影色09]From: Misty[/n]To: [玩家][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]I'm going to keep training here at[/n]this Gym.[/p]When I get better, I'd love to hit[/n]the road and travel.

[文本色08][阴影色09]From: Lt. Surge[/n]To: [玩家][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Hey, kid![/n]You electrified me in our battle![/p]I didn't know that there were[/n]gutsy Trainers like you.[/p]It made me change my mind about[/n]you!

[文本色08][阴影色09]From: Erika[/n]To: [玩家][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]I am so glad that there are strong[/n]Trainers like you.[/p]That awareness alone inspires and[/n]motivates me to try harder.[/p]Please visit me again.[/n]Zzz[...]
[文本色08][阴影色09]From: Koga[/n]To: [玩家][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]You and I, we must both set our[/n]sights higher and work towards[/l]meeting our challenges.[/p]Now, I must go train my daughter.
[文本色08][阴影色09]From: Sabrina[/n]To: [玩家][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]The love you have towards your[/n]Pokémon[...][/p]It was a power that was never[/n]bested by my psychic power.
[文本色08][阴影色09]From: Blaine[/n]To: [玩家][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]My fire Pokémon![/n]They'll become even more powerful![/p]And now, a quiz. How many kinds of[/n]Fire-type Pokémon are there?
[文本色08][阴影色09]From: Lorelei[/n]To: [玩家][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]I needed to thank you for your[/n]help.[/p]But that has nothing to do with our[/n]battles.[/p]You'd better watch out next time!
[文本色08][阴影色09]From: Bruno[/n]To: [玩家][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]The super power of your Pokémon[/n]and you I've experienced myself.[/p]Next time, maybe I should show you[/n]how to train yourself.
[文本色08][阴影色09]From: Agatha[/n]To: [玩家][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]When you grow older, don't you[/n]dare go soft like that coot Oak![/p]Be like me and keep battling on!

[文本色08][阴影色09]From: Lance[/n]To: [玩家][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]I'm considering going back to my[/n]hometown.[/p]I want to retrain my Dragon-type[/n]Pokémon and strengthen them.[/p]I'd like to invite you to my[/n]hometown one day.

[文本色08][阴影色09]From: Bill[/n]To: [玩家][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Hey, there! Celio had nothing but[/n]praise for you.[/p]Hearing that makes me happy.[/p]When you catch some rare Pokémon,[/n]come show me, okay? Promise!
[文本色08][阴影色09]From: Mr. Fuji[/n]To: [玩家][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]Instead of hoping for the happiness[/n]of just your Pokémon[...][/p][...]Can I get you to wish for the[/n]happiness of all Pokémon?
[文本色08][阴影色09]From: Giovanni[/n]To: [玩家][/p][文本色02][阴影色03]There is nothing that I wish to say[/n]to you.[/p]I will concentrate solely on[/n]bettering myself, and none other.
